g.text: Startpage: a static page cloned from Git at pod start
Public, no auth. Three replicas, one per worker; each pod clones the page itself.
startpage pod × 3 (one per worker, required anti-affinity)
Why a Git clone, not a ConfigMap:
the repo is far over the 1 MB cap.
a failed clone must never block the
Sources: docs/services/startpage.md. Rotating the key: new pair, new deploy key on GitHub, vault kv put, update the 1Password mirror, restart the Deployment.
